The one-woman show

Kali VanHoof.

A licensed esthetician who opened Rowdy Roan in 2025 and made the room hers — the skull on the wall, the mountains painted up the side, the blanket on the bed. It's a studio for women only, and it's just her: she's the one who answers, books, and does the work. She lit the candle on year one this May.

Before you come in

Good to know.

The 24-hour rule

Cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours before your appointment. Inside 24 hours, a 50% fee of the booked service applies — it's a one-person calendar, so a no-show is a lost afternoon.

More than 15 minutes late cuts into your slot and may mean rescheduling, with the same 50%.

Pause the retinol

For lashes, brows and waxing: stop retinol and other skin thinners 7–14 days before you come in. Day of, arrive with no eye makeup and don't curl your lashes.

The Firming Facial is a no-go if you're allergic to egg, cocoa, raspberry, pineapple, papaya or citrus; have very sensitive skin, active rosacea or severe couperose; or just had a chemical peel or use Retin-A, Renova or Accutane.

Paying

Visa, MasterCard, Discover, debit and cash. Affirm on Vagaro lets you split anything over $50 into four payments.
